commit_scope: Implementation, CPU tests and launch runbook. This receipt is committed separately.

implementation.control_master: yes for the persistent master, no for sessions
implementation.shared_pool_scope: All agents/worktrees using the same Linux/WSL client and OS user; independent of arm, run and PID
implementation.missing_master_fallback: ProxyCommand=false prevents a session from silently opening a direct connection
implementation.platform: Linux/WSL OpenSSH; native Windows fails before starting SSH

api.command: command(host, remote_command, timeout=None, legacy=None) -> gated subprocess argv for cpuV; original argv for other hosts
api.rsync_shell: rsync_shell(host) -> remote-shell command string using the same pool for cpuV
api.cli: python -B -m tools.coopmwm.cpuv_ssh [--timeout SECONDS] run -- 'COMMAND' | put LOCAL ABSOLUTE_REMOTE | get LOCAL ABSOLUTE_REMOTE | rsh cpuV COMMAND...
api.timeouts: CLI default 180 seconds; 0 inherits caller lifetime. Existing RPC timeout is forwarded, while Popen streams and rsync retain their external owner limits.
api.python_script_remote_calls: tools.coopbandit.ops.remote automatically routes cpuV; caller binds PYTHON['cpuV'] to the qualified interpreter
integrations: tools/coopbandit/ops.py shared remote operations used by tools.coopmwm.ops.ssh
tools/coopmwm/cpus_checking.py configurable RPC and both rsync transfers
api.runbook: CLEAN1_LAUNCH.md section F6: cpuV SSH connection discipline

arm_invariants.A: No policy, learning, reward, observation, RNG, bank or training configuration files changed; infrastructure admission only.
arm_invariants.B_R: One identical arm-independent transport, pool, rate and timeout policy; guidance sources and learning semantics untouched.
arm_invariants.other_hosts: Existing argv retained, with regression coverage for cpuQ.

tests.skip_reason: Unix permission and symlink checks require POSIX; host is Windows.
coverage: Master creation once, persistent socket reuse across client instances, no inherited-pipe wait on background master
Two-second admission spacing including failed connections, commands and transfers
No automatic replay after master failure, timeout, missing control socket or lost command stream
SCP and RPC/rsync routing, binary input/output preservation, command quoting and exit status
External lifetime preservation for streaming clients and rsync
Native Windows rejection before subprocess execution
Gate timeout, release on exception and real three-process serialization with persisted rate state
Existing checker and bounded read-only transport retry regressions

open_issues: Live Linux/WSL master/socket/transfer qualification remains pending because this task forbids SSH. All network subprocesses in the new CPU tests were faked or blocked.

All operating agents must use the documented shared Linux/WSL client, cpuV alias and wrapper; native Windows SSH and alternate direct-access paths do not satisfy F6. Existing alias/identity/known-host setup is an operator prerequisite.
